notes.title: THE TRIPLE 5 UPDATE
notes.content:
[img]https://i.ibb.co/TzrswLH/patch-Notes3.gif[/img]
First ever real content update for KIPIDON. This one introduces a new difficulty called [b]Impossible Mode[/b]!

Unlocked after beating the game, [b]Impossible Mode[/b] allows you to play through previous levels with a myriad of differences (different requirements, stricter time limits, modified level design, etc.) that make the original 10 levels extremely difficult to pass!

Along with that, [b]the game has also updated to support controller[/b]! Playing a shooter with a controller is typically not the best choice, but if you have to or just want to, you can now!

[i]Here is a full list of all the changes[/i]:
[list]
[*]Added Impossible Mode! (Unlocked after beating main game)
[*]Added controller support
[*]Music Paks now respawn even if they've been previously collected
[*]Grown Kipidon Flowers now refresh the Heart Streak timer
[*]Stats are now available for each civilian located in the Collection Menu. Use this to your advantage to decide the best routing for levels
[*]Cleaned up Morning/Mid-Day skybox
[*]Fixed issue where Nat & other end-game characters would shoot faster standing still instead of while moving
[*]You can now scan his code!
[*]Reduced the chances of culling visibility desync for certain objects
[*]Major Performance Improvement for FINALE
[*]Other Minor Performance Improvements
[*]Decreased Heart Rank score requirement for Cloudland Plaza (32100 -> 32000)
[*]Added TimeCat's bucket
[/list]

[h1][b]Changes[/b][/h1]

[list]
[*]Removed unnecessary shadow calculations and other rendering stuff for certain transparent objects. (Improves performance everywhere but especially FINALE)
[*]Fixed issues where sound effect from KipiFlies explosion animation would desync

[*]Slightly extended Chime's Heart Streak timer (1.47sec -> 1.485sec)
[*]Fixed issue where the 30 sec left sound effect would play even when HUD is invisible
[*]Fixed out of bounds seam in Tutorial Planet
[*]Altered some credits
[*]Updated Steamworks stuff
[/list]

Enjoy my video game.

notes.title: KIPIDON DEMO UPDATE v0.4.9.2
notes.content:
Hi! This will probably be the final update to the demo unless something game breaking is in it as I type this (which their shouldn't be lol). Through getting feedback from friends and strangers alike, as well as re-evaluating the game on my own, here are some of the changes made to improve the game!:

[h1]Changelog[/h1]
 
[list]
[*]Added a new dash move that can be temporarily activated by double tapping forward.
[*]Adjusted rank requirements to be less unfair.
[*]Added dialog text that explains what Rapid Shot is, as it was kind of confusing to most players.
[*]Rapid shot no longer requires stamina because that is stupid.
[*]Light performance optimizations.
[*]Redone HUD face animations.
[*]Added a new state to the flower icon in the gameplay HUD so that your progress in a level is a bit more clear.
[*]Fixed a crash that would occur if you fail the Residential section of the 4th level and then try any level.
[*]Renamed second level to "City School District" because it makes more sense and doesnt sound like a fucking sonic the hedgehog level.
[*]Added an option that allows you to only render the game in it's original resolution.
[*]Resolution option shows the dimensions of the window. (This is hidden when in fullscreen, as to avoid any confusion of it having any effect in fullscreen)
[*]Fixed area in the Cicada Residential District where you could jump out of bounds.
[*]Made the Residence area of the Cicada District a little more easier to notice.
[*]Fixed issue where the framing of one camera in the 2nd level's cutscene would be messed up if playing in a 4:3 aspect ratio resolution.
[*]Added high score to the level select.
[*]Decreased font size of the level descriptions in the level select.
[*]Added a new scene to the 4th level's cutscene.
[*]Fixed issue where heart points and score accumulated after timer went out didn't get added to the score when reaching the rank screen. (e.g. if u collected CDs after the timer went out or if u got someone right after the timer expired).
[*]Fixed verrry minor issue where the internal count of your total collected heart points would be doubled temporarily (this never became much of an issue since it corrects this during autosaving. but i still decided to fix this just in case.)
[/list]
